chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 0315: The Dao Calls Its Children. The Stage is Set.
chapter_meta_description: Hidden geniuses, a nine-times-reincarnated drunk, and a possessed Golden Crow all feel the Dao’s pull. The Immortal Fortunes Assembly is about to begin.
og_title: The Dao Is Calling—And Ji Ning’s Biggest Challenge Yet Awaits
og_description: A mysterious call from the void drags hidden monsters out of hiding. Chapter 0315 sets the stage for the most epic tournament in the Grand Xia.
twitter_title: Hidden masters feel the call! The Grand Xia Tournament is about to get CRAZY
twitter_description: Strange cultivators abandon their posts, a nine-life drunkard wakes up, and Ji Ning reunites with his crew. The hype is real.

lore_anchors.definition: A famous Wanxiang-level cultivator of the North Sea. In this chapter, he is revealed to be the second true body of a man named Bu Yi.
A grand tournament held by the Grand Xia Dynasty to recruit the most talented Wanxiang Adepts from across the realm; winners are often taken as disciples by supreme powers of the Three Realms.
The original physical body of a cultivator, as opposed to a second true body or an avatar.
A second, independently powerful body cultivated by splitting one's soul. It acts as a separate entity that can be in two places at once.
The periodic ordeals faced by cultivators below Celestial Immortal; minor disasters every three hundred years and major calamities every nine hundred years.
The central marketplace of a commandery city, backed by the Grand Xia royal clan. Cultivators can buy and sell treasures here.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are these geniuses suddenly feeling a 'call' to the Assembly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Desolate Era setting, the Dao itself is alive and conscious. When a cultivator's destiny is tied to a major event, the universe sends a 'premonition' directly to their soul, guiding them toward their fate.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Golden Crow Immortal (Bu Yi's second body) become a Celestial Immortal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He possessed a Golden Crow egg, but his human soul and Yao beast body have only 70-80% 'compatibility.' This mismatch makes the Tribulation nearly impossible to survive for a creature with such a pure, powerful bloodline.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is so special about the drunken girl?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She hints that she has reincarnated nine times. In Xianxia, reincarnation chips away at the soul's foundation. Nine lives is usually the absolute limit, making this her last desperate chance to 'become an Immortal' or be erased from existence.
